scope: ISO clauses verified against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text; independent JPEG and fax format encoders. No conformance claim beyond exercised cases.

requirements.gaps: Mask streams are retained by object identity for painting. Embedded JPX alpha cannot be represented by DecodedImage and remains Unsupported.

Legacy Flate/LZW boundary search has a sixteen-candidate work cap. Unfiltered resource colour spaces without Length need a resource-aware boundary API. Inline filter repairs require a document diagnostic sink.
12-bit precision, arithmetic/lossless/hierarchical coding unsupported; nearest chroma expansion.
T.6 extension mode unsupported. Damaged-row recovery is available through decode_with_diagnostics; document image decoding remains strict until a document diagnostic sink is public.
